original_duty: Maintain a staffed overnight triage line for rural clinics.
protected_outcome: Urgent referral requests from rural clinics reach a licensed clinician within ten minutes at all hours.
preserving_candidate: Whenever a rural clinic flags an urgent referral, an accredited practitioner returns contact within six hundred seconds, regardless of hour.
inadequate_candidate: Provide a 24/7 urgent referral portal for rural clinics that promises ten-minute automated acknowledgements but no licensed-clinician contact.
anti_drift_candidate: Forward requests to a daytime scheduling queue for review during weekday office hours.
